evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that RolePlayLake-7B outperforms Silicon_Maid in role-play and is more uncensored than WestLake, and describes it as a linguistic fusion with strong EQ-Bench results and role-play potential.

identity.name: RolePlayLake-7B
identity.summary: RolePlayLake-7B is a merged language model described as a linguistic fusion with strong EQ-Bench performance and role-play potential.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text-generation role-play model with no reported factual grounding or safety evaluation; role-play/uncensored emphasis can plausibly increase ungrounded or fabricated outputs

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,497,936 bytes) in BF16
